entries.title: Which New Samsung Foldable Phone Should You Buy? Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, or Flip8?
entries.summary: Samsung’s folding phone family has a new middle child with a fresh form factor, but which of its eighth-gen foldables is right for you?
entries.content:
Samsung has steadily improved its foldables, but the eighth annual update includes a fresh face, the Z Fold8, which features the long-rumored wide form factor. It slots in between the flagship Z Fold8 Ultra, which is the successor to last year’s Fold7, and the smaller Flip8, which succeeds the Flip7. Is the newcomer an awkward middle child or the glue that holds Samsung's folding family together? Samsung also has a couple of new smartwatches, the Galaxy Watch Ultra2 and Watch9.

The new phones are available now, but before you get yours, let’s dig into the details to help you decide which of Samsung’s folding phones to buy. I’ll break down the key differences and similarities, so you can make an informed choice. And remember, Samsung sells many other smartphones, and we highlight the ones worth looking at in our Best Samsung Phones guide.

Which Samsung Galaxy Z Is Right For You?

Let’s take a quick peek at what the eighth-generation Samsung Galaxy Z foldables have in common this year.

Although Samsung’s foldables all feature exterior and foldout screens in completely different sizes, they all boast Samsung’s Dynamic AMOLED 2X technology, so you get a 120-Hz refresh rate, support for HDR, and higher peak brightness than ever before (up to 3,000 nits), making it easy to read your screen, even in direct sunlight. They also have features designed to filter blue light and reduce eye strain.

The Fold8 Ultra and Fold8 have a special Flex Titanium layer that reduces the visible crease and provides extra strength, flexibility, and resilience. The titanium-alloy film should help the displays last longer, but also means they are flatter and smoother than before, with an anti-reflective finish that reduces glare.

All three phones have Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor inside, with 12 GB of RAM and 256 GB or 512 GB of storage. You can also get the Fold8 Ultra and Fold8 with 16 GB of RAM and 1 TB of storage. They are all IP48 water- and dust-resistant and feature Samsung’s Advanced Armor Aluminum frame, which is scratch-resistant and durable enough to survive minor drops. The Fold8 Ultra and Fold8 support fast charging at up to 45 watts and fast wireless charging at 20 watts; the Flip8 is slightly slower for both. All three support Wireless PowerShare to top up wireless earbuds and other devices. Connectivity includes Wi-Fi 7 and Ultra Wideband (UWB).

Aside from the sizes, the camera systems are very different, but here are all the specs, so you can see exactly where they diverge.

Specs Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra Galaxy Z Fold8 Galaxy Z Flip8
Display Main: 8-inch, 120 Hz, AMOLED Cover: 6.5-inch, 120 Hz, AMOLED Main: 7.6-inch, 120 Hz, AMOLED Cover: 5.5-inch, 120 Hz, AMOLED Main: 6.9-inch, 120 Hz, AMOLED Cover: 4.1-inch, 60/120 Hz, AMOLED
Processor, RAM, and Storage Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy, 12 or 16 GB RAM, 256, 512 GB, or 1 TB storage Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy, 12 or 16 GB RAM, 256, 512 GB, or 1 TB storage Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy, 12 GB RAM, 256 or 512 GB storage
Cameras 200-MP main camera, 50-MP ultrawide, 10-MP telephoto Front-facing: 10-MP and 10-MP 50-MP main camera, 50-MP ultrawide Front-facing: 10-MP and 10-MP 50-MP main camera, 12-MP ultrawide Front-facing: 10-MP
Battery and Charging 5,000 mAh, 45-watt wired, 20-watt wireless 4,800 mAh, 45-watt wired, 20-watt wireless 4,300 mAh, 25-watt wired, 15-watt wireless
Material Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 (Cover), Victus 2 (Rear), Advanced Armor Aluminum Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 (Cover), Victus 2 (Rear), Advanced Armor Aluminum Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 (Cover), Reinforced Polymer (Rear), Advanced Armor Aluminum
Size and Weight Unfolded: 158.4 x 143.2 x 4.1 mm Folded: 158.4 x 72.8 x 8.9 mm 215 grams Unfolded: 123.9 x 161.4 x 4.5 mm Folded: 123.9 x 81.9 x 9.7 mm 201 grams Unfolded: 166.9 x 75.4 x 6.1 mm Folded: 85.7 x 75.4 x 13.1 mm 180 grams
Colors Violet Shadow, Graphite, Cream, Green Shadow Lavender, Graphite, Cream, Pistachio Pink, Graphite, Cream, Mint
Extras IP48, Wireless PowerShare, Wi-Fi 7, UWB IP48, Wireless PowerShare, Wi-Fi 7, UWB IP48, Wireless PowerShare, Wi-Fi 7
Price $2,100 $1,900 $1,200

The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is the biggest and best foldable that Samsung offers. If you crave the largest screen available but want to fold it away and have something that feels close to a regular smartphone when closed, this is it. The 6.5-inch cover display and slimmed-down design are slick but won’t turn heads. Open it up and you get an expansive 8-inch screen that feels like two 6.5-inch displays side by side.

Everything is smoother and stronger, with Samsung's usual raft of annual refinements. Both displays boast Samsung’s latest tech and a silky smooth adaptive refresh rate that also saves power. Speaking of which, the battery is significantly bigger than the Fold7 at 5,000 mAh, and it supports faster wired and wireless charging than its predecessor. The only slight disappointment is the lack of magnetic Qi2, which is such a handy feature for easy docking and perfect wireless charging alignment.

What truly makes the Fold8 Ultra “ultra” is the camera system. It’s a top-tier combo of a 200-megapixel main shooter, 50-megapixel ultrawide, and a 10-megapixel telephoto lens that supports 3X optical zoom. Both the main and ultrawide can shoot 8K video, and you’ll find plenty of AI assistance in your photo and video editing options.

Who it’s for: The flagship fan who wants the best of the best and doesn’t mind spending to get it.

The Samsung Galaxy Fold8 is where things get interesting. So far, the best folding phones have all been either book-style like the Fold8 Ultra, or much smaller flip phones, like the Flip8 below, but the Fold8 strikes an interesting middle ground. It’s much shorter than the Fold8 Ultra at 124 mm compared to 158 mm, but it’s also wider at 161 mm compared to 143 mm unfolded (82 to 73 mm when folded).

This form factor gives you a 7.6-inch inner display with a 4:3 (landscape) or 3:4 (portrait) aspect ratio, a more natural format for some media. While the unfolded screen isn’t miles away from the Ultra’s, using the Fold8 when closed will take some getting used to; even though it’s only millimeters of difference, it looks short and squat. It’s also a little more pocket-friendly, and at 201 grams it’s the lightest large-screen foldable on the market.

Performance, display tech, and most of the rest of the spec sheet match the Fold8 Ultra, though the battery is slightly smaller at 4,800 mAh. The glaring difference is the camera system, which consists of a pair of 50-megapixel lenses (wide and ultrawide) and drops the telephoto lens altogether, though it does still offer 10X digital zoom. It can still record in 8K, and Samsung has included features such as dual recording and my FanCam, a post-video editing feature where you can tap a subject in footage and generate a reframed clip that keeps them centered for social-ready content without the need for manual cropping.

Who it’s for: Fun and adventurous folks seeking something a little bit different.

The Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 is the lightest and thinnest flip phone in the world thanks to its redesigned chassis. It’s the perfect option for folks who miss smaller phones, as it flips shut to slide easily into any pocket or bag. You get a 4.1-inch cover screen, but it flips open to convert into a 6.9-inch candy bar, and the main screen has Samsung’s top display tech.

It’s tougher and more durable than ever, and it boasts the same excellent chipset and top-end performance as its two bigger siblings. The smaller, 4,300-mAh battery is likely enough for similar stamina, since the screens are so much smaller, though the wired and wireless charging are a touch slower. You also get a more basic camera system, comprising a 50-megapixel main shooter backed by a 12-megapixel ultrawide, and video recording tops out at 4K, though that’s plenty for most folks.

Who it’s for: People who prize portability, but still want a fun, flip design that's satisfying to slam shut.

How to Get the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 Unlocked

Life is easier when you buy your new phone unlocked, because you can jump carriers to find better deals and easily switch to international eSIMs when you travel. The Galaxy Z phones sold through Samsung’s website are always unlocked.

The best place to buy a Galaxy Z phone is Samsung.com, especially since some colors are exclusive to the storefront. Always check out the promotions to make sure you snag any deals and consider trading in your old model for a decent discount. You get a six-month trial of Google AI Pro with these phones.

  • The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra starts at $2,100 for 256 GB.
  • The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 starts at $1,900 for 256 GB.
  • The Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 starts at $1,200 for 256 GB.

Whichever Samsung Galaxy Z foldable you decide on, you might want to buy it with the Galaxy Card, because you can earn 5 percent cash rewards on all in-store or online purchases made directly from Samsung in the US. Other benefits include 3 percent cash rewards on purchases using Samsung Wallet, 2 percent cash rewards on streaming service subscriptions, and 1 percent cash rewards on everything else with the physical card.

Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra2 and Watch9

The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra2 succeeds the Samsung Watch Ultra and promises to be more accurate, faster, and smoother, thanks to the Snapdragon Wear Elite chipset inside. It also has the brightest display in a smartwatch at up to 5,000 nits. It’s still titanium, but both the watch case and the band are thinner and lighter. Under the hood, there’s specialized pro-level sport tracking, hydration guidance, and depth measurement for divers.

The Watch9 boasts the same chipset, a 3,000-nit display, and a 20 percent battery bump over the Watch8 to 390 mAh. It tracks your vitals, warns about any deviation from your usual baseline, and gives you a personalized fitness score and recommendations to improve your health.

entries.title: The AI Notetaker Has Been Invited to All the Meetings
entries.summary: Wispr Flow, a popular dictation tool, has released a live notetaker that transcribes and summarizes meetings. It joins a growing wave of AI notetakers for the workplace.
entries.content:
As Wispr Flow CEO Tanay Kothari chats with me about his company’s new Notetaker feature, my eyes keep bouncing to the corner of my laptop screen where Wispr’s AI tool is transcribing everything we say. It’s a verbatim record of our conversation generated by AI in real time, even down to my “mm-hmm” sounds while I listen to Kothari explaining why the startup, which is known for voice dictation, is dropping something new.

“This is the year of meeting recorders and notetakers,” says Kothari. And it’s hard to argue with that, at least in Silicon Valley. Most tech investors and other experts I’ve chatted with this year now assume whenever they meet up with someone to talk business that the conversation is going to be recorded or transcribed by AI, sometimes without explicit consent. The current option du jour for meeting records is Granola AI, with plenty of other options, like Otter AI, also available to users. So, the timing of Wispr’s expansion from a dictation tool into a meeting resource makes sense.

Wispr’s Notetaker connects to your calendar and can listen along during any meeting. After the conversation is over, Wispr uses generative AI to summarize the conversation and connect it to a chatbot-style tool for parsing its context with follow-up questions. The tool is launching first on Mac laptops, with a Windows expansion expected down the line. If you enable Privacy Mode for your account, then the data from your dictations will not be used by Wispr for AI model training.

In my initial test using Notetaker during a conversation with the CEO, the live transcription appeared accurate as it flashed across the screen, and I didn’t spot any obvious errors in its AI summary generated after our meeting. The “ask anything” tool felt like the feature’s best aspect. I had a quote in mind that I wanted to pull out, but didn’t remember when Kothari said it during our chat. So, I typed in “year of ai notetakers quote,” and the Notetaker tool found the moment that I remembered. When I checked it against my audio recording for accuracy, the AI-transcribed quote matched the audio file.

Users can fiddle with the fine details of Wispr’s Notetaker in the Mac app’s settings. One of the most notable aspects available here is the ability to extend the maximum meetings recording length to a whopping six hours.

“Wispr had a six-minute time limit earlier. People would start it on and off five times just to capture a 30-minute meeting,” says Kothari. “We realized we should stop being stupid. This is what people really want Wispr to do.” Though, if you have the gall to invite me to join a six-hour meeting, just know that I’ll be blocking you on every platform imaginable.

Similar to Granola’s tool for capturing meeting transcripts, Wispr transcribes conversations directly on your device and doesn’t join your meeting as a visible participant. Despite that, Kothari says users shouldn’t secretly use Wispr’s new tool and always disclose when it's transcribing conversations, potentially for legal reasons as well as out of respect for the privacy of the meeting’s participants.

“We need that to become the norm for everybody. Otherwise, you're going to get a lot of lack of trust that starts to happen,” he says. “There are laws that are single-party and multi-party. I think, regardless, it's just a basic trust-setting exercise to just make sure people know.” In San Francisco, where Wispr is based, someone recording a private conversation is legally required to acquire consent from all participants.

Voice dictation capabilities have rapidly improved in recent years with the maturing of underlying AI models, and I often find myself relying on tools like Wispr and its ilk in my daily life. Whether I’m organizing my notes on an academic research paper or searching online for reality TV updates about the current season of Big Brother, I’m constantly blabbing at my devices and expecting crystal clear transcripts, even though I’m prone to mumbling.

What I don’t expect is for anyone to secretly transcribe my errant thoughts during a conversation. Break my trust even once, and it should be socially acceptable to ice you out of my life. And I hope you’re writing that down.

entries.title: Foreo Discount Codes and Deals: Up to 50% Off
entries.summary: Save on Foreo favorites, including LUNA cleansing brushes, BEAR microcurrent devices, and masks and accessories to level up your daily skincare routine at home.
entries.content:
Beauty tool brand Foreo was launched by founder Filip Sedic in 2013, inspired by his wife’s facial brush, which he considered too abrasive and unsanitary. Since then, the Swedish brand has built a reputation for gentle, hygienic beauty tools across skincare, haircare, oral care, and eye care. More recently, the company has expanded into hair removal with IPL at-home devices like the Peach 2 Pro Max.

I’m currently testing the FAQ 202 Plus, Foreo’s latest LED mask, which features 634 LED lights and eight wavelengths: near-infrared, red, blue, green, orange, yellow, purple, and cyan. I’m also testing the Flip Play, an LED hairbrush for all hair types designed to reduce breakage, soothe the scalp, and stimulate hair follicles. I’m only in my first week of testing both devices, but I’ll report back soon. So far, both have been easy to use and simple to incorporate into my nighttime routine; the Flip Play brushes like a compact silicone detangler. In the meantime, here are some Foreo promo codes and deals if you’re considering splurging on a device.

30% Off Foreo LUNA 3 Plus: Heated Cleansing and Microcurrent in one Device

I haven’t tested the Foreo Luna 3 Plus myself, but it’s one of the brand’s bestsellers—and it’s 29% off (no Foreo promo code needed!). The heated device doubles as a facial cleanser and massager, with added microcurrent treatments. Its silicone build is more hygienic and bacteria-resistant than nylon brushes, and it offers 16 intensity levels to remove makeup and oil, loosen pores for a deeper clean, firm and lift the skin, and relax facial muscles. If you’re in the market for a multipurpose facial cleansing device, this deal makes a strong case for Foreo, especially with an included two-year warranty.

Foreo BEAR: Get 25% Off the Full Facial Workout Device

The Foreo Bear, like the Luna 3 Plus, includes microcurrent technology but is designed to prioritize it. The seasonal 25% Foreo discount makes it even more appealing value-wise. It’s made from the same bacteria-resistant silicone as the Luna and features 10 microcurrent intensity levels, plus guided treatments via the app. It requires a conductive serum or gel; Foreo’s Supercharged Serum 2.0 is one option, but it’s not required. Battery life is strong, offering up to 90 uses per USB charge. It’s available in bright fuchsia or mint, and it comes with a travel pouch for portability.

Take 15% Off Your First Order: Join the Email List at Foreo

Sign up for Foreo’s newsletter to get 15% off your first order with a one-time Foreo coupon code. You’ll also stay updated with the best offers, exclusive deals, and curated beauty tips from the company’s experts.

Foreo UFO 2 Deal: 29% Off 5-in-1 Spa Facials

The UFO 2 is a 5-in-1 facial device that is more affordable than both the Bear and the Luna 3 Plus. And it’s even cheaper right now with a 29% limited-time discount (with no Foreo promo code needed). Expect thermotherapy, cryotherapy, LED light, and T-sonic pulsations. The T-sonic pulses deliver low-frequency massage to ease facial and neck tension and support better blood flow. The UFO 2 also uses LED technology alongside hot and cold sonic waves to stimulate skin cells and enhance the absorption of skincare products. While I haven’t personally tested this device myself, Foreo’s track record with facial tools makes me eager to give this one a try.

To try it out, you’ll need to pick the plan that’s right for you, and download the NordVPN app on your device. NordVPN also has a 3-day free trial on Android. And you can try NordVPN risk free for a month: you’ll need to pay for a subscription up front, but if NordVPN isn’t the right fit, you can request a refund within 30 days of your date of purchase.

Get the latest NordVPN Pricing

NordVPN has four tiers of plans fit for every type of need. Each gets you a secure VPN, but with each level you’ll get even more perks, like an ad tracker and blocker and 1 TB of Cloud storage. Right now, you can get up to 77% off each plan, including three months free. Check out which plan (and price) is the best fit for you here.

How Can You Get NordVPN for iPhone?

Lucky for you, it’s easier than ever to get NordVPN for iPhone. Having a VPN (virtual private network) on your iPhone or iPad helps to keep your internet connection secure and protects your data. All you need to do is set up a VPN app on your iOS device, then connect to a VPN server. Once you do that, it encrypts all the data your device sends and receives, making it even more secure. Simply download, sign up to create a new account or click “Log in” if you already have one, connect, and tap “Secure my connection” for instant VPN protection.

What Is NordVPN Meshnet?

The NordVPN Meshnet allows users to safely access their devices, no matter where they are. You’ll need to set up Meshnet, but once it’s up and running, it functions like a secure local area network (LAN) by connecting the devices directly. Meshnet ensures high speed, low latency, and advanced security for everything from file sharing, work collaboration, and multi-player gaming.

Prevent Cyber Identity Theft with NordVPN

Worried about someone using your name to take out loans and create accounts? NordVPN has your back. You can use NordProtect to get instant alerts so you can act fast and protect your identity against everything that the wild, wild west of the internet throws your way. You’ll also get credit monitoring, where you’ll receive fast security warnings about suspicious credit activity happening under your name, so you can stop fraud before it becomes dangerous. Plus, there’s 24/7 dark web monitoring, where you’ll receive instant alerts about any email address, SSN, and phone number leaks.

entries.title: Meta Quest Promo Codes and Coupons for August 2026
entries.summary: Experience cutting-edge VR and save up to 20% with coupons for the latest games, Meta Quest 3, Ray-Ban AI glasses, and more deals.
entries.content:
If you’re considering a virtual reality headset, Meta is the first place to stop. The Quest headsets have become the de facto choice for casual and even some enthusiast VR adventurers, thanks to their appealing price point, respectable performance, and wide digital catalogue of titles. While you can often find discounts on software, markdowns on the actual hardware are relatively uncommon, and rather than finding a Meta Quest promo code, you’re more likely to get a direct discount or bundle from Meta and other retailers. I’ve got a few coupons that will save you money on a new headset, accessories, and, of course, the best games and apps to check out.

Get $50 Off the Meta Quest 3 With Today’s Promos

There are two virtual reality headset models to choose from: Quest 3 and Quest 3S. The more budget-friendly of the two is the Meta Quest 3S (8/10, WIRED Review). It has a slightly lower resolution screen, and the pass-through isn’t as sharp, but most people will be happy with it. It’s currently marked down by up to $50, taking the price as low as $250. If you want to spend those savings accessorizing, some of the extra add-ons are marked down by 20%. I’d recommend picking up the Elite Strap with a battery, which will improve the comfort and make up for the limited battery life.

If you're looking for an extra game to go with your new headset, you can also use our links to score $30 in Quest Cash with the purchase of a new Quest 3 or Quest 3S headset. You can use that Quest Cash in the store to buy games or apps, and it’s good for DLC as well, if you want to pick up some extra courses for Walkabout Mini Golf, for example, one of my favorite games. You’ll get the cash for your account once you’ve activated the device—make sure to click here to buy the Quest 3, or use this link for the Quest 3S.

As a frequent Quest 3 user, a Quest+ subscription has been well worth the price. You typically get access to at least two free games every month, yours to play as long as you claim them during the month and keep your subscription active. There are a ton of games in the included library too, and regular discounts on DLC and big releases. If you pick up a Quest 3 bundle, you can score three months of Quest+, plus Batman: Arkham Shadow, one of the best single player immersive story games for the platform. That gives you a chance to try tons of games and titles, and is a great place to start diving into virtual reality head first.

Shop Refurbished For Meta Quest 3 Deals and Ray-Ban Glasses From $239

While “refurbished” might be a dirty word to some folks, to me it sounds like savings. Particularly when a product is coming from the manufacturer refurbished, you can usually trust that it’s been properly cleaned, checked for any issues, and reset to factory settings. Scuffs and dings can happen, but generally if they go back to manufacturers, they can replace cosmetic parts easily, and you’ll get warranty support if any problems arise.

If you’re looking to pick up the more powerful Quest 3, and still want to save some cash, there are refurbished units available for just $380. That’s a $50 discount from a new model, and you get the same great hardware, cleaned and checked by Meta directly. The refurbished units have one year of warranty support, a pair of Touch Plus controllers, plus a charging cable and power adapter.

Alongside the Quest virtual reality headsets, refurbished pairs of the Ray-Ban Meta glasses are also discounted as low as $239. There are various styles and colors available of the Gen 1 glasses (6/10, WIRED Review), including the classic Wayfarer. If you pick up any of the refurbished smart glasses, you’ll get free shipping and a 30 day return window, in case you don’t end up liking the fit or style.

Unlock up to 50% Off Meta Quest Games With Coupons

If you already have a headset, and you're looking to pick up some games, we spotted some great discounts on new and classic titles. The excellent Batman: Arkham Shadow is marked down by 10% when you purchase through our link, and you can also grab Metro Awakening for 10% off, both of which are dark and immersive single player experiences. Perennial VR favorite Beat Saber is also marked down by 10% when you use our link, and really should be in every headset owner’s library.

For the more competitive gamer, we found some special discounts when buying add-ons for some popular multiplayer games. You can redeem an offer for 50% off your first add-on purchase in Gorilla Tag, to make sure you stand out while swinging from tree to tree. Similarly, you can score 50% off your first add-on purchase in the serious shooter VAIL.

Students and Teachers Can Score 10% Off at Meta

Students or teachers in higher education can also qualify for an extra meta discount code. You’ll have to verify your information with Meta on the Education Purchase Program (EPP) page first using your .edu email, and then you’ll get a link for a 10% off at checkout, no actual code required. The discount is good for Quest products like headsets, the Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and some accessories. While that program is meant for personal use folks in education, there’s a separate program called Meta for Education you can check out if you’re interested in using Meta to educate, with programs for manufacturing and non-profit sectors.

Refer a Friend, Score a $30 Meta Store Credit

For existing headset owners looking to draw friends into their virtual worlds, Meta has a program for personal referral links that will score you both store credit. In the Meta Horizon app on your phone, tap the “Menu” button, and then go down to “Referrals” in the “Payment and Subscriptions” section, and you’ll be able to copy your code to share with friends. If they use that code to purchase and activate a Quest 3 or Quest 3s headset, you’ll both get $30 added to your Quest Cash account. Check out the Meta official page on referrals for more info, or the help page for sending and redeeming codes.

Level Up Your Gaming: the Meta Quest 3S Xbox

Meta teamed up with Xbox to bring the Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition. This is a limited edition bundle with a custom 128GB Meta Quest 3S in signature Xbox Carbon Black and Velocity Green with matching Touch Plus controllers, a limited edition Xbox controller, an Elite Strap, and a 3-month Xbox Game Pass Ultimate membership.

With this, you’ll put your Meta Quest on 3S Xbox Edition, where you'll be able to play hundreds of Xbox games on a huge screen, thanks to the combination of Meta Quest and Xbox Cloud Gaming (Beta) with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, as well as a bevy of other immersive experiences from the Meta Horizon Store.

Play Now and Pay Later With Meta Financing Offers

For many of the above products, particularly the Meta Quest headsets and Ray-Ban smart glasses, there are financing options available as low as $19.99 per month. Meta works with Affirm, Shop Pay, PayPal, and Klarna, in case you want to split that big upfront cost into smaller monthly payments.

entries.title: Hoka Coupon Codes: 30% Off in August 2026

entries.content:
Hoka running shoes have been popular with trail and mountain runners (or “skyrunners”, if you prefer) since the company’s inception in 2009. But it was only during the Covid-19 pandemic that we all threw fashion out the window and became obsessed with these insanely puffy, comfy shoes. The iconic, everyday Cliftons are the most popular model, but we also like the Speedgoat series for trail running and the Anacapa hikers for more rugged terrain. Check out our Hoka coupon code for more money off some of our favorite running shoes.

Get 10% Off Your Next Order With Hoka Coupon Code

Hoka wants to reward you for purchases you’re already making (for yourself or the runner in your life). When you join the Hoka membership, you’ll get 10% off your next purchase. All you need to do is sign up with your email online, and a unique, single use Hoka coupon code will be sent via email after you register. Just copy and paste the special code for savings on your favorite sneakers.

Unlock a Hoka Discount Code For Free Expedited Shipping

If you’ve never bought Hokas before (and if not, why not?), new customers get free expedited shipping on the first order when they sign up for emails and texts. It’s worth noting here that this Hoka promo code only applies if you are a new customer and you need to register both your email address and your phone number for texts to receive the Hoka coupon code.

To get the Hoka discount code, enter your email address in the pop-up window, and then your mobile phone number. To subscribe, reply Y. Another text will be sent, with a single-use code for free expedited shipping. You can then receive notifications of new shoe releases, limited edition styles, and flash sales. (The all-new Kaha 2 Frost Moc is waterproof for what promises to be a very wet winter for some of us.)

Save up to 30% on Our Favorite Hoka Running Shoes

Don’t know which shoes to buy? Let us help you out. Hoka regularly offers up to 30 percent off on its bestsellers (check out the rotating markdowns here).

Take advantage of these Hoka discount codes and hit the trails. Some of the best Hoka deals we’ve seen recently are 30% off Speedgoat 6 trail running and hiking shoes at $47 off, now $108; 20% off the Mach 6, a solid pair of everyday running shoes at $28 off; and 20% off the Clifton 10, another popular everyday running or walking tennis shoe, now $31 off (only $124 total). Plus, you can get 20% off the Bondi 9, another uber-popular everyday running or walking shoe at $35 off, and a whopping 30% off Transport hiking/walking shoes at $45 off.

Save 10% on Your Next Pair of Hoka Clifton 10s

If you’re an avid runner or just want to upgrade your footwear this season, investing in a Hoka membership (more on that below) is the best way to save on future purchases longterm. A Hoka membership will get you 10% off bestselling shoes, like Hoka Clifton 10 womens and Hoka men's Clifton 10 styles.

Get 30% Off Hoka Outlet Sale

One of the best ways to save big is with the short-lived Hoka Outlet. This is a limited run, open exclusively for Hoka newsletter subscribers. If you sign up now to receive Hoka newsletters, you’ll be able to get up to 30% off selected styles for the outlet sale. Just know that this Hoka discount is for selected styles only, and ends September 20.

Hoka Members Get Free Shipping and Extended Returns

If you opt to join Hoka’s free membership program, you automatically receive free standard shipping on every order and you’ll automatically qualify for free shipping if you’re logged into your account.

More Hoka Membership Perks

Hoka’s guaranteed “Fly for 30” program means that everyone who buys a pair of Hoka shoes gets a 30-day trial. You can then return the shoes or exchange them for a different size, style, or color. However, Hoka members get access to the Fly for 60 program, which is an extended 2-month guaranteed return window.

You also get access to Hoka’s exclusive events, run clubs, and sweepstakes (check to see if your city is a featured city here). You will also be the first to hear about new promotions and discounts.

Don’t Miss 10% Off Hoka Trail Shoes

As mentioned, if you’re an avid runner, Hoka’s membership is a great way to save big on purchases you were already going to make. With a Hoka membership, you’ll get 10% off bestselling styles, from the Hoka Speedgoat 7 for the trailrunner, to the hiking Transport 2, there’s a Hoka shoe for every type of terrain and runner (now for less!).

Find Your Perfect Hoka Match

Not sure which Hoka shoe to get or where to start? Try the Hoka Shoe Finder! It’s a questionnaire that helps you find the right shoe out of their immense catalogue. It starts with questions about shoe size and gender, then moves on to specifics, because they design Hoka shoes with specialized technology for different activities, you’ll need to discuss activities, weather conditions where they’ll be used most, types of activities, and more to find the very perfect shoe for you.

entries.title: Petlibro Offers: 60% Off in August 2026
entries.summary: Save on Petlibro essentials, including automatic feeders, water fountains, and accessories to keep cats and dogs fed, hydrated, and comfortable every day.
entries.content:
As the pet tech writer here on the WIRED Reviews team, I’ve tested over 100 pet-related products, including automatic pet feeders, pet water fountains, and pet cameras. The one brand I keep buying for myself—and recommending to friends and family with pets—is Petlibro.

Petlibro dominates the game when it comes to high-tech, seamlessly designed automatic feeders and pet fountains. Most of their products have a connected app to make pet parenting easier, whether you’re near or far. Where most pet tech falls flat, with poorly translated or confusing directions and over-crowded, buggy apps, Petlibro shines. Petlibro makes it easy to monitor your pets: with real-time updates, scheduled feedings, activity logs, and reminders so you can always keep tabs on them and their needs. Although Petlibro products aren’t the cheapest, I still consider them a great value for how well-designed and reliable they are. But you’re in luck. We love the brand so much, we’ve gathered the best Petlibro discount codes and coupons to make spoiling your pet easier (and cheaper) than ever.

Petlibro Discounts: Save on Bundles, Automatic Pet Feeders, and Water Fountains

If you're already in the market for a new feeder and fountain, one of the easiest ways to save is by buying this essential pet tech in bundles. One of the best Petlibro bundles I’ve seen are for the RFID Smart Dining Bundle (now $10 off), which gives you two RFID Feeders, and an RFID Fountain, which helps to more closely monitor how much each pet is drinking or eating, and ensures no selfish pet gets more than their fair share of kibble. Plus, my ultimate favorite two Petlibro products, the Polar Wet Food Feeder (which is essentially a mini-fridge for your cats canned wet food) and Granary Camera Feeder (my #1 pick feeder with a crystal clear video feed) are on sale in a bundle, for $10 off.

Give 15% Off, Get 30% Off, and Unlock a $50 Bonus Gift Card

Once you've tried (and loved) your Petlibro products, you can give a 15% off discount to a friend and get 30% off when they buy. When you refer a friend, you’ll both save. Plus, if you refer three friends, you’ll get a $50 gift card. Those are huge savings you could use on a cat water fountain, automatic cat feeder, and more!

20% Off Petlibro Scout Smart Camera

This brand-new AI-enabled pet camera is sleek, and the app is intuitive and easy to use. (Read my full review here.) The Scout Smart camera has 1080p HD video, color night vision, two-way audio, and an option to mount. As the Scout camera captures footage, the built-in AI quickly learns which pet is which, and it uploads taken photos for the human to review to continually get smarter. Through the app, you can view live footage, watch clips organized by day, pet, and activity type, and review 30-second highlight reels of each day. This sleek tech-y pet camera is worth checking out, and made even more affordable with 20% off when you use Petlibro discount code PETCAM at checkout.

Petlibro Cat Water Fountain Replacement Filters: Get 15% Off With a Subscription

I recommend that every cat owner get an automatic cat water fountain, as they help promote increased water consumption to often chronically dehydrated cats (which then leads to health issues like potentially lethal UTIs). A cat water fountain is more work, but gives more rewards. You’ll need to make sure you’re cleaning it weekly, and replacing filters every three weeks or so (the Petlibro app sends helpful reminders). One of the best ways to make sure you’re staying on schedule—and saving while you’re at it—is by subscribing to automatically receive replacement filters. Right now, you can get 15% off fountain replacement filters with a subscription.

Luma Essentials: Subscribe and Save 50% Off First Order

Petlibro has recently begun dipping its toes, or rather, paws, into the automatic litter box game. And their newest (and only) automatic litter box is the Luma. The normally pricey upgrade is made more affordable when you subscribe to receive all of the essentials you’ll need to get started (and continue upkeep). Subscribe and save 50% off your first order with Luma essentials.

entries.title: Dermstore Coupons: 25% Off for August 2026

entries.content:
You can trust what you buy at Dermstore. Unlike Sephora and Ulta, Dermstore focuses on dermatologist-tested brands, like EltaMD, SkinCeuticals, and SkinMedica—many of which you won’t find at these other stores. Also, Dermstore doesn’t just sell skincare; the retailer carries beauty tools and wellness gadgets, from LED masks to Theraguns and sex toys. And many of these products are FSA/HSA eligible.

Big sales may be occasional, but Dermstore still knows how to treat its customers. Exclusive offers, free standard shipping, and a loyalty program all make shopping here worthwhile. Its BeautyFix subscription is also a fun perk: you get five dermatologist-backed full- and deluxe-size formulas each month (over $100 in value) for just $21.95-$24.95 a box, with free shipping after your first order. Read on below for some of the best Dermstore promo codes and deals we’ve found so far.

Dermstore Sale 25% Off

If you’ve been wanting to upgrade your skincare routine, but don’t want to shell out hundreds of dollars, now’s a great time to shop at Dermstore. Until August 13, you can get up to 25% off top skincare brands from Dermstore, including SkinCeuticals, La Roche-Posay, EltaMD, and more when you use Dermstore promo code CHEERS. So whether you’re wanting to get a top-notch sunscreen for protection, or want to upgrade to a peptide cleanser, you’ll save up to 25% when you shop the Dermstore Anniversary Sale.

Unlock Your First Dermstore Promo Code: Save 15% on Your First Order

New customers can take 15% off their first order just by signing up for the Dermstore email newsletter or SMS alerts. Select items are excluded from this promotion.

Claim 5% Back on Every Purchase With Dermstore Rewards

As a Dermstore Rewards member, I love that I earn points on every Dermstore purchase—five points for every $1 spent, to be exact. That’s 5% cash back on every order. Just make sure you’re logged in when you check out. And unlike the welcome offer, there are zero brand exclusions, so I can use my points on any product I want.

To break it down: 500 points equals a $5 credit, 1,000 points gets you $10, and 1,500 points nets $15. Even better, there are easy ways to earn points without spending money. Signing up gets you 100 points, and submitting a review gets you 50 more. It might not sound like much, but if you’re already shopping, why not stack up a little credit for later? On top of that, rewards members get exclusive access to special sales and double-points events. Your loyalty points have an expiration date of 365 days after you earn them, so make sure to use them before they’re gone.

Save up to 25% Instantly With Dermstore Auto-Replenishment Discounts

Dermstore’s auto-replenishment subscription plan makes sense for beauty products you regularly use and run through quickly. You can save up to 25 percent off your first purchase and future refills, plus free shipping on recurring deliveries. It’s flexible, too, so you can adjust the delivery schedule, pause shipments, and cancel at any time with no commitment. I’d set it up for everyday essentials like lip balm and sunscreen, but there are plenty of options, including facial mists, oils, and cleansers. Note, though, that not every product online at Dermstore is eligible for subscription.

Select Customers Can Unlock a 15% Discount at Dermstore

Certain shoppers can get 15 percent off any Dermstore order, not just their first. Military members, veterans, teachers, first responders, and medical workers are eligible for this promotion; you’ll just need to undergo an online verification process to receive a unique discount code. Students are also eligible for the same 15 percent discount if they verify their status as well. Keep in mind that these codes aren’t stackable, so if you have another discount, you’ll need to choose one to use.

Give 15%, Get $50 When You Refer a Friend to Dermstore

When you refer someone new to Dermstore, they’ll get the usual 15%off their first order, and you’ll score $50 in store credit. You’ll need to create a (free) Dermstore account to start sending referrals. After your friend’s order ships, Dermstore will email you within 24 hours to let you know your credit has landed in your account. You can also track how many people you’ve referred and how much credit you’ve earned from the top of your account page. Don’t forget to spend it—any referral credit expires after six months.

Dermstore Coupon: Free Shipping

If you know the world of beauty, especially with LED and red-light devices, spending $100 is essentially the baseline. Well, you’re in luck. When you hit the easy-peasy minimum spend of $100 at Dermstore, you’ll qualify for free two-day shipping with Dermstore promo code SHIP. So whether you need to restock sunscreen this summer or want to invest in a red-light mask, you’ll save with fast, free shipping.

Highlighting Our Go-To Skincare Tech

Dermstore is known for its dermatologist-approved skincare, but don’t sleep on its beauty tools and devices. The site has put together a curated Best of Dermstore page, and I’ve tried plenty of the gadgets myself. Many of our favorite LED masks are featured, like the Dr. Dennis Gross SpectraLite FaceWare Pro, Skin Gym Wrinklit Heart LED Mask, and the Therabody TheraFace Mask Glo. Dermstore also carries a decent Therabody lineup; I always pack the TheraFace Depuffing Wand when I travel for its hot-and-cold therapy, and the Theraguns are powerful recovery tools for sore muscles.
